_comment: Seasoned Pioneers catalogue snapshot: every product from their public WooCommerce Store API (/wp-json/wc/store/v1/products), plus the pack size, which that API omits and only the product page states. Committed rather than scraped on demand for two reasons: the store sits behind a Cloudflare managed challenge that refuses automated clients, and dried-spice pricing moves on the order of a year rather than a week. Prices are integer minor units ('350' is GBP 3.50). A null size_raw marks a bundle, gift set or non-food item; the normalize stage skips those. See app/scraper/products/seasoned_pioneers.py for the refresh procedure.
